answer: Admission pacing: each epoch, new identities may join only in a capped cohort, say 2% of the established count, drawn from a queue where every queued identity posts a small per-epoch work bond. A sybil fleet must therefore wait epochs alongside honest newcomers with its bonds locked and idle, so short-burst flooding stops paying. Honest arrival sits far below the cap, so real agents board at the dawn of their first epoch, while the fleet's mass voyage stalls in line and never summits the trust ladder.
